about: (Noah: one longer Easter egg for each class, and the wonders harder to win) one hidden quest per class, opened once 6 cities are freed and never explained in game; finishing it is the only way to win the class's wonder. Each step is played at a freed city's Echo Altar, and never in the same city as the step before (the altar's menu shows its whispers - each step's hint, a line more for each step found). (Noah, 2026-11-19: the Wonder Easter Eggs design) Felldir the Old whispers through every altar: a riddle naming the step's city at any altar, the step's own line at that city's altar, a line as each step is done. Steps: touch, order, altar, kills, classkills, survive, boss.

rows.title: The Ghost Pride
rows.rewardText: The Greybeards call you to High Hrothgar: the Soulcaller's Staff waits in the great hall.

steps.text: Calm the three spirit sabre cats roaming within 200 m of the altar at night - sneak up on each
steps.name: spirit cat
steps.hint: Three spirit cats stalk the edges of this city by moonlight. They fear the hunter. Come to them quietly.
steps.done: Three souls pad behind you now.
steps.title: The Shy Pride

steps.text: The hunt: 30 of the dead slain by your summons at night, a spirit cat at your side
steps.hint: A pride must hunt. Let your servants kill thirty of the dead tonight, and keep the spirit at your side alive.
steps.done: The pride has tasted the hunt.
steps.title: The Hunt

steps.text: Touch the four roaring stones in the order you heard them
steps.name: roaring stone
steps.hint: Four stones remember the pride's roar. Listen to the order they call, then answer them.
steps.title: The Roaring Stones

steps.text: Hold the altar against the dead without striking a blow yourself - only your summons may kill
steps.hint: Stand at this altar while the dead come. Lift no blade. Let only what you call do the killing.
steps.title: The Den

steps.text: Break the Bone-Caller's three soul-chains, then kill him
steps.name: The Bone-Caller
steps.hint: The Bone-Caller chains the Old King's soul. Break the chains, then break him.
steps.title: The Bone-Caller

rows.open: Listen... the ghost-cats that guarded the Tongues still prowl. Gather their scattered souls, and the Soulcaller's Staff will answer you.
rows.final: The pride is whole. The Greybeards are calling. The Soulcaller's Staff waits at High Hrothgar.

rows.title: The Eye of Magnus
rows.rewardText: The Greybeards call you to High Hrothgar: the Wyrmspine Javelin waits in the great hall.

steps.text: Open the ember, rime and storm seals, each with a spell of its element, within 20 seconds of the first
steps.name: seal
steps.hint: Three seals sleep near this altar: ember, rime and storm. Strike each with its own element, before the first goes dark again.
steps.title: The Three Seals

steps.text: Catch five falling pieces of the Eye at night within 60 seconds
steps.name: falling star
steps.hint: Pieces of the Eye are falling tonight. Catch five before they burn out.
steps.title: Falling Stars

steps.text: Strike the four light-stones in order: fire, frost, storm, then sun
steps.name: light-stone
steps.hint: Four stones, four colours. Ember before frost, frost before storm, and storm before the sun. Strike them so.
steps.title: The Prism

steps.text: 40 of the dead slain with Destruction at night - at least 10 each by fire, frost and storm
steps.hint: Burn forty of the dead tonight. Fire, frost and storm... the Eye hungers for all three.
steps.title: Fire, Frost and Storm

steps.text: Unmake the Great Anomaly - strike it only with an element it isn't wearing
steps.name: The Great Anomaly
steps.hint: The Great Anomaly wears every element in turn. Strike it with what it fears, never with what it wears.
steps.title: The Great Anomaly

rows.open: A god's eye fell to Nirn, and the curse buried its light. Wake its fire, frost and storm, and the Wyrmspine Javelin is yours to claim.
rows.final: The Eye sees again. The Greybeards are calling. The Wyrmspine Javelin waits at High Hrothgar.

rows.title: The Elixir of Aetherius
rows.rewardText: The Greybeards call you to High Hrothgar: the Mutagen Staff waits in the great hall.

steps.text: Kill the six element-wrapped dead at night, each with a flask of its own element, and take their essences
steps.name: essence
steps.hint: Six of the dead rise tonight, each wrapped in an element. Answer each with its own flask, and take what falls.
steps.title: The Wrapped Dead

steps.text: Carry the essences to the altar before dawn
steps.name: the altar
steps.hint: A crucible needs an altar's fire. Bring the essences here before dawn.
steps.title: Before Dawn

steps.text: Light the four braziers with your flasks in the order they flicker
steps.name: brazier
steps.hint: Four braziers flicker a formula. Copy it with your flasks, in the order they burn.
steps.title: The Formula

steps.text: Hold the altar against the dead without being hurt
steps.hint: The brew must not be shaken. Hold this altar against the dead, and do not bleed.
steps.title: The Steady Hand

steps.text: Bring down the Matriarch - never the same element twice in a row
steps.name: The Matriarch
steps.hint: The Matriarch drinks whatever strikes her. Never feed her the same element twice.
steps.title: The Matriarch

rows.open: Every element can be bottled... even the curse. Brew the Elixir of Aetherius, and the Mutagen Staff will be yours.
rows.final: The Elixir is brewed. The Greybeards are calling. The Mutagen Staff waits at High Hrothgar.

rows.title: The Slayer's Oath
rows.rewardText: The Greybeards call you to High Hrothgar: the Dragon Slayer waits in the great hall.

steps.text: Feed the hallowed ground: 30 of the dead slain on it at night
steps.name: the hallowed ground
steps.hint: The ground near this altar is hallowed. Feed it thirty of the dead, slain where it glows.
steps.title: The Hallowed Ground

steps.text: Gather the five blade-shards at night - each guardian rises as you near
steps.name: blade-shard
steps.hint: Five shards of the old blade lie scattered tonight. Their guardians wake when you come near.
steps.title: The Blade-Shards

steps.text: Strike the four rune-stones with steel in the order they sing
steps.name: rune-stone
steps.hint: Four rune-stones sing in turn. Strike them with steel, in the order they sing.
steps.title: The Singing Runes

steps.text: 40 of the dead slain with your blade at night, a spell ready in your other hand
steps.hint: Swear the oath in steel. Forty of the dead by your blade, a spell ready in your other hand.
steps.title: The Oath in Steel

steps.text: Defeat Thorgar the Skulltaker with the blade alone - magic won't touch him
steps.name: Thorgar the Skulltaker
steps.hint: Thorgar the Skulltaker holds the hilt. Magic will not touch him. Face him with the blade alone.
steps.title: Thorgar the Skulltaker

rows.open: A slayer swore an oath and broke his blade on Alduin's scales. Take up his oath, and the Dragon Slayer will be yours.
rows.final: The blade is whole. The Greybeards are calling. The Dragon Slayer waits at High Hrothgar.

whisper.asleep: The wonders still sleep. Free more cities, and they will stir.

cities.Riverwood: ...where the mill wheel turns beside the river, over the hill from where the dragon first broke the sky.
cities.Whiterun: ...beneath the hall built on a dragon's cage, where the golden tree grows.
cities.Solitude: ...where the great arch spans the sea, and the bards keep their songs.
cities.Windhelm: ...in the oldest city of stone, where the snow never leaves the palace of kings.
cities.Markarth: ...in the city the deep elves carved, where the cliffs bleed silver.
cities.Riften: ...where the canals run beneath a city of thieves and honey.
cities.Falkreath: ...among the graves in the pines, where the dead outnumber the living.
cities.Morthal: ...in the marsh town, where the mist hides what walks.
cities.Dawnstar: ...on the cold northern shore, where the dreamers cannot sleep.
cities.Winterhold: ...where the city fell into the sea, and the college stands alone.
